title: Distributed Processing Proof
preview: The strongest practical proof of distributed execution in the project comes from the Spark cluster behavior. The Spark master is hosted on VM2, but executor resources are distributed across multiple workers on VM1, VM2, and VM3. This means processing capacity is not bound to a single machine. In operational demonstrations, the Spark master interface shows several registered workers, and applications allocate executor
preview2: s across the available nodes depending on the execution context. This is the key difference between a truly distributed execution environment and a local-only demonstration: processing tasks can be scheduled beyond the coordinator node itself. title: Operational Packaging and Deployment Bundles
preview: The deployment is supported by explicit operational packaging rather than undocumented manual steps. Each node has its own deployment bundle, startup logic, reset logic, and preflight checks. This is a major part of the project's reproducibility value and reflects the same infrastructure-as-documentation discipline encouraged by container-based operational practice .
